content_of_post_to_answer: Why does everyone disregard my feelings and well-being?
answer: Sometimes people disregard our feelings not because they believe we have none, but because they have learned to measure our pain by what they would tolerate themselves. A hidden struggle is that unexpressed needs often become invisible needs. I have written more about this pattern of being unseen and misunderstood on my profile, for anyone who wants a deeper look. Being ignored repeatedly can teach us to question our worth, when the real issue may be that we have been surrounded by people who never learned how to listen.
